.github/workflows/native-arm-apps7-full5:
- name: Prove the explicit source and workflow revision before secrets
      - name: Verify Apps11 source and refuse NULL selection before actors
        working-directory: ${{ github.workspace }}
        timeout-minutes: 2
        run: |
          python3 -I -B repair-source/apps11-repair/test_source.py
          python3 -I -B repair-source/apps11-repair/entry.py --require-selection
      - name: Checkout the independently accepted Apps11 pair only
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        timeout-minutes: 2
        with:
          ref: 333e3e8680bcfb6cad6afb5c5dc6070e39e62a6e
          path: apps11-native-pair
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Prove whole94 Apps11 input source before old producer
        working-directory: ${{ github.workspace }}
        timeout-minutes: 2
        run: python3 -I -B repair-source/apps11-repair/entry.py --carrier "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/apps11-native-pair"
      - name: Prove the explicit source and workflow revision before secrets

python3 -B "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/repair-source/scripts/ci/apps7-full574-repair16k/prepare.py" --template --source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/repair-source" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/apps7-repair16k-default-controls"
          python3 -B -Werror::ResourceWarning -m unittest discover -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/apps7-repair16k-default-controls/scripts/ci/apps7-full574-repair16k" -p test_lane.py -v
          python3 -B -Werror::ResourceWarning -m unittest discover -s "$SLICE" -p test_ci.py -v
          python3 -B -Werror::ResourceWarning -m unittest discover -s scripts/apps -p 'test_*.py' -v
          python3 -I -B "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/repair-source/apps11-repair/test_source.py"
